title: Modernization value narrative
content: Sequence modernization around measurable business journeys, retire constraints incrementally, and demonstrate value through production increments rather than a multi-year platform replacement.

title: Retail resilience narrative
content: Protect revenue-critical customer journeys with progressive delivery, resilience testing, autoscaling, observability, and rehearsed rollback before peak trading periods.

title: Responsible AI narrative
content: Combine governed use-case selection, approved grounding, evaluation, human review, and adoption measurement so generative AI moves safely from experimentation to repeatable value.

title: Data product narrative
content: Organize delivery around owned data products with explicit consumers, quality measures, contracts, and reusable platform capabilities.

title: Application decomposition narrative
content: Use domain boundaries and business transaction analysis to identify the smallest valuable services to extract while preserving operational continuity.

title: Grounded agent assist narrative
content: Ground suggested responses in curated operational knowledge, expose confidence and citations to agents, and require human confirmation for consequential actions.

title: Security uplift narrative
content: Prioritize remediation by exposure and business criticality, implement reusable guardrails, and validate controls through operational evidence.

title: Adoption narrative
content: Translate technology capabilities into persona-led scenarios, equip champions, remove friction, and measure sustained behavior change rather than attendance.

title: Platform engineering narrative
content: Create a paved road of self-service templates and secure defaults, then improve it using product feedback and engineering performance data.

title: Governance cadence
content: Use a weekly delivery forum, fortnightly product demonstration, and monthly executive outcome review with clear decisions, owners, and escalation paths.

title: Knowledge transfer
content: Pair customer practitioners with delivery specialists, capture decisions in reusable playbooks, and progressively transfer ownership before the final milestone.

title: Outcome measurement
content: Baseline a small set of business and delivery measures at mobilisation, define accountable owners, and review evidence at every governance checkpoint.

title: Discovery output
content: Discovery produces validated outcomes, prioritized scope, target architecture, delivery roadmap, dependency map, risk register, and a mobilization-ready backlog.

title: Incremental delivery
content: Deliver thin end-to-end increments early, validate with users, and use evidence to adjust scope while protecting the committed outcome.

title: Assumption management
content: Record assumptions with an owner, validation date, and consequence; convert invalid assumptions into explicit decisions or backlog changes.

title: Retail commerce modernization case study
content: A fictional European retailer modernized six high-change commerce services using strangler migrations. Release lead time fell from 21 days to four days and peak incidents reduced by 35%.

title: Professional services AI pilot case study
content: A fictional advisory firm delivered two grounded copilots with mandatory expert review, evaluation gates, and approved knowledge. Pilot users saved an estimated 90 minutes per matter.

title: Manufacturing data products case study
content: A fictional manufacturer created a shared data platform and three plant data products. Reporting latency moved from days to under one hour across the pilot sites.

title: Insurance claims modernization case study
content: A fictional insurer extracted claims notification and status services, reducing customer status calls by 18% while retaining its core policy platform.

title: Travel service copilot case study
content: A fictional travel company grounded agent suggestions in disruption policies and CRM context, reducing average handling time by 22% in a controlled pilot.

title: Automotive platform engineering case study
content: A fictional mobility company introduced secure golden paths for three teams, cutting environment wait time by 60% and increasing weekly deployments.

title: Discover Design Deliver Adopt
content: A four-stage method: align outcomes and evidence; co-design the target and backlog; deliver production increments; embed ownership, measurement, and continuous improvement.

title: Cloud migration factory
content: Assess and wave-plan applications, establish repeatable landing patterns, migrate in controlled batches, validate operations, and capture lessons into the factory backlog.

title: Responsible AI delivery lifecycle
content: Frame the use case, identify harms, curate grounding, prototype, evaluate quality and safety, deploy with human controls, and monitor outcomes.

title: Data product onboarding method
content: Select a valuable use case, name owner and consumers, define quality contracts, onboard sources, release a minimum data product, and operationalize support.

title: Azure modernization assessment
content: A time-boxed assessment covering business drivers, application portfolio, platform readiness, modernization options, delivery waves, cost assumptions, and risk.

title: Foundry AI accelerator
content: A focused service for use-case selection, Foundry foundations, grounded prototype delivery, evaluation, responsible AI controls, and adoption planning.

title: Data platform foundation
content: Establish secure platform capabilities, ingestion patterns, catalog and governance integration, observability, and the first reusable data product.

title: Application modernization sprint
content: Validate domain boundaries, build a production-grade vertical slice, establish delivery automation, and create a prioritized modernization roadmap.

title: Adoption and change enablement
content: Develop persona scenarios, stakeholder plan, champion network, communications, learning assets, feedback loops, and benefit tracking.

title: Small accelerator effort model
content: Typical assumption: 4–5 specialists for 8–12 weeks, with customer product owner and subject-matter experts available two days per week.

title: Product team effort model
content: Typical assumption: a cross-functional team of 7–9 for 16–24 weeks, plus customer architecture, security, test, and product participation.

title: Platform programme effort model
content: Typical assumption: a platform core of 5–7 plus 2–3 embedded use-case teams, phased according to onboarding demand and dependency readiness.

title: Commercial assumptions
content: Cloud consumption, third-party licenses, customer travel, tax, and specialist services outside the named scope are excluded unless explicitly stated.

title: Outcome-led proposal template
content: A reusable twelve-section proposal structure covering executive context, customer challenges, solution, scope, deliverables, approach, milestones, assumptions, dependencies, risks, success criteria, and next steps.

title: Cloud modernization proposal template
content: A proposal template emphasizing modernization waves, landing-zone readiness, application dispositions, operating model, migration governance, resilience, security, and measurable cloud outcomes.

title: Responsible AI accelerator template
content: A proposal template for governed AI adoption including use-case framing, grounding, evaluation, responsible AI controls, human review, adoption, and value measurement.
